_comment: INTERIM golden for the Option B click-tracking oracle. Each event = a {name, locator} the Phase-6 harness resolves on BOTH prod (erp.intuit.com) and ours (feature preview / localhost), clicks, then intercepts+ABORTS the eventbus /t POST on both sides, forces the batched flush, and diffs the per-click fields + event name (the ~47 shared context is inherited from the injected tracker and excluded). `expected` is the pinned prod capture (2026-08-20) for offline/reference runs. Swap in the customer's ~50-page set Friday. Locators are text/role-based so they resolve across the WordPress prod DOM and the EDS DOM.
_ignoreNote: experiment_ids/personalization_details are page/session-dependent (allow-list until the customer freezes experiments); site_section is page-constant context; the rest are per-event metadata that legitimately vary run-to-run.
